summary: Sheet #39 Beta Features / Feature Flags — backend fully verified (18/18 pytest passed in test_beta_features_sheet39.py) and mobile user flow verified end-to-end. Backend: GET /api/features returns 3 seeded flags (ar_personalization, bulk_buying, real_estate_mode) with can_optin=true and correct shape (opted_in, enabled_for_me); POST /api/features/{key}/optin flips enabled_for_me→true after opt-in; 404 on unknown key; 400 on non-optin/disabled flag (verified with user_type-only test flag). POST /api/beta-feedback returns 'bug' tag for crash/error keywords, 'friction' for rating<=2, 'suggestion' by default. Admin GET /api/admin/features includes optin_count+feedback_count. Admin POST creates flag; 409 on duplicate key; 400 on invalid rollout_type. Admin PATCH updates enabled+rollout_type+rollout_value (verified user_type/pro combo); 404 unknown; 400 invalid rollout_type. Admin DELETE removes flag AND pulls it from users.beta_optins (verified via user's /features list post-delete). Admin analytics returns correct shape (flag, optin_count, feedback_count, avg_rating, useful_pct, tag_breakdown, recent[]) — verified avg_rating math, tag counts (bug/friction/suggestion all appeared) and 404 on unknown. Non-admin correctly 401/403 on /api/admin/features. Frontend mobile 390x844 (demo_home@diyhomie.com): Profile → 'Beta Features' row (testID profile-beta) → /beta screen loads with intro text and 3 feature cards. Each has correct testID beta-toggle-<key>; ar_personalization already toggled ON from earlier tests (ENABLED FOR YOU tag visible + feedback box rendered). Toggled bulk_buying → ENABLED FOR YOU appeared + feedback box (emoji 1-5, comment TextInput, Send button). Sent feedback for bulk_buying (rating 5 + 'TEST_UI love this feature'): input cleared, rating reset, button returned to 'Send feedback' — send flow works (Thanks! ✓ appears for 2.5s per spec; not caught by my 3s screenshot but state reset confirms success; backend feedback_count also increased in later pytest runs). Toggled bulk_buying OFF for cleanup. Admin UI (web /admin, Diyhomieapp@gmail.com): I was unable to authenticate through the UI in an automated way — the /admin route silently redirects unauthenticated users to '/' (no visible admin-login form appeared in 3 attempts across cleared cookies/localStorage/fresh contexts, since preview session state persists in ways Playwright can't easily reset). Because of the Loop-Prevention rule I stopped after 3 tries. Code review of /app/frontend/src/components/admin/FeaturesModule.tsx and /app/frontend/app/admin/index.tsx confirms all required testIDs are wired: admin-nav-features, feat-add-toggle, feat-new-key/label/create, feat-enable-<key>, feat-rollout-<key>-<type>, feat-analytics-<key>, feat-analytics-close, feat-del-<key>. All admin endpoints they call are backend-verified. Main agent should self-verify the admin UI in a fresh browser (see should_main_agent_self_test=true). No React Native red screens. No deprecated packages detected in the new Sheet #39 files.

issues: Each emoji button has paddingVertical: 6 and shares width via flex:1 (~66px tall × ~48px wide on 390px screen). Vertically that is ~32px which is below the 44px minimum touch target; bumping paddingVertical to spacing.sm/md would bring it up. Not blocking — taps still register in testing.
styles.fbSend paddingVertical: spacing.xs (~4px) yields ~28px tall touch target — should be ≥44px. Cosmetic priority.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py:3759 _flag_on_for_user: correctly handles all 5 rollout types incl. off/all/optin/user_type(pro|paying|admin)/region(with _neighborhood_key fallback). Good.
server.py:3783 _flag_public: returns can_optin only when enabled AND rollout_type=='optin' — matches spec exactly. enabled_for_me flips via _flag_on_for_user. ✓
server.py:3811 /features/{key}/optin: 404 unknown, 400 if not optin-type OR not enabled. Uses $addToSet / $pull — safely idempotent. Push notification on opt-in. ✓
server.py:3834 /beta-feedback: tag priority is bug > friction > suggestion; comment truncated to 1000 chars; rating clamped [0,5]. Solid.
server.py:3894 admin_delete: correctly pulls flag key from all users.beta_optins after delete (verified by test). Good side-effect handling.

server.py:3883 admin_update_feature: safely whitelists allowed fields. Does not return updated doc — clients must re-fetch (FeaturesModule.load() correctly does this). Minor nit — could return the updated doc for efficiency.
beta.tsx: 134 lines, StyleSheet.create used, all text in <Text>, testIDs on toggle/rate/comment/send/back, api errors handled with Alert.alert. Clean.

FeaturesModule.tsx: 219 lines, testIDs on every interactive (feat-enable/rollout/analytics/del/add-toggle/new-key/new-label/new-create/analytics-close). Uses api() helper with method+body — no hardcoded URLs. AddFlagForm sanitises key with regex — good.

AnalyticsSheet renders inline as sheet inside the ScrollView (not a Modal). Works fine given the desktop /admin layout but on very narrow viewports it will just append below the list — acceptable per current design.

success_rate.frontend: user-flow 100% verified on mobile; admin UI code-reviewed only (unable to auth automatically)
